mapper.select:
SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.code, kb.description, kb.icon, kb.embedding_model, kb.chunk_size, kb.chunk_overlap, kb.separator, IFNULL(doc_stat.document_count, 0) AS document_count, IFNULL(chunk_stat.chunk_count, 0) AS chunk_count, IFNULL(doc_stat.total_tokens, 0) AS total_tokens, kb.status, kb.sort_order, kb.created_by, kb.created_at, kb.updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_id, COUNT(*) AS document_count, IFNULL(SUM(token_count), 0) AS total_tokens FROM ai_knowledge_document GROUP BY knowledge_id ) doc_stat ON doc_stat.knowledge_id = kb.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_id, COUNT(*) AS chunk_count FROM ai_knowledge_chunk GROUP BY knowledge_id ) chunk_stat ON chunk_stat.knowledge_id = kb.id
AND kb.status = #{status}
AND (kb.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR kb.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY kb.sort_order ASC, kb.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE code = #{code} AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_base (name, code, description, icon, embedding_model, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, `separator`, document_count, chunk_count, total_tokens, status, sort_order, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{description}, #{icon}, #{embeddingModel}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkOverlap}, #{separator}, 0, 0, 0, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_base kb SET kb.document_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE knowledge_id = kb.id), kb.chunk_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE knowledge_id = kb.id), kb.total_tokens = (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(token_count), 0) FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE knowledge_id = kb.id), kb.updated_at = NOW() WHERE kb.id = #{id}
